Play-out, Group A: 5th of 7 | website = https://gloria2018.ro/ | kit_alt1 = | pattern_la1 = _hummelcoreXKbw | pattern_b1 = _hummelcoreXKSbr | pattern_ra1 = _hummelcoreXKbw | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = | body1 = | rightarm1 = | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = 000000 | kit_alt2 = | pattern_la2 = _hummelcorepoly1718ab | pattern_b2 = _hummelcorepoly1718ab | pattern_ra2 = _hummelcorepoly1718ab | pattern_sh2 = _hummelcore1718ab | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = | body2 = | rightarm2 = | shorts2 = | socks2 = 75AADB }} '''Clubul Sportiv Gloria Bistrița''', commonly known as '''Gloria Bistrița''' or simply as '''Gloria''', is a professional [[Football (soccer)|football]] club based in [[Bistrița]], [[Bistrița-Năsăud County]], competing in [[Liga II]], the second tier of [[Romanian football]]. Founded in 2018 as 1. FC Gloria Bistrița, the team is widely regarded as the unofficial successor of [[ACF Gloria Bistrița]], sharing its name, white and blue colors, stadium, and former staff and players. In 2021, the club was taken over by the Bistrița-Năsăud County Council, renamed Gloria Bistrița-Năsăud, and changed its colors to black and red. In 2025, following its promotion to Liga II, the club dropped "Năsăud" from its name to strengthen its identity and align more closely with the Municipality of Bistrița.{{cite web|url=https://liga2.prosport.ro/liga-3/gloria-bistrita-nasaud-isi-schimba-denumirea-nu-si-forma-de-organizare-19355670|title=Sunt gata actele la Bistrița!
